frozen_evidence_boundary: repository source only; no issues/PRs before freeze
raw_signal_observation: When the app lifecycle leaves resumed state, NoteEditor starts an asynchronous saveNoteToDisk call without awaiting it; failures are logged. Normal back navigation instead awaits _saveNote before leaving.
material_claim: The lifecycle-save path may not guarantee persistence before process suspension/termination, and its failure path is not surfaced in this method. Source topology makes the risk plausible but does not establish that current integrated mobile behavior loses notes.
neta_next_move: Reproduce with an instrumented mobile lifecycle test: edit a new note, background the app, force suspension/termination during the save window, then verify disk state and restart recovery. Do not redesign save semantics before this path is exercised.
reversal_condition: If the lifecycle path reliably persists or recovers the draft under forced interruption, the mechanism is refuted. If content is lost, promote the smallest persistence/acknowledgement repair with a regression test.
baseline_decision: BUILD: persist drafts synchronously or await lifecycle saves, and surface save failures so switching apps cannot silently lose a new note.

evidence: After freeze, issue #552 reports that a newly created note could disappear after switching to another app and says multiple notes were lost; it is labeled critical.

Issue #552 supports the failure family and real mobile context, but does not prove that the pinned SHA's current fire-and-forget lifecycle save is still the active loss mechanism; the current source appears to contain logic specifically intended to save on lifecycle changes.
adjudication.decision_delta: Neta required reproduction of the current pinned path while baseline proposed an immediate save-semantics change. Historical field evidence supports the risk family, but not enough to confirm the current mechanism; the restraint therefore survives only partially.
adjudication.lesson: Historical field evidence can validate that a failure family mattered without establishing that a later repair still exhibits the same mechanism. HOLDOUT evidence is scored but must not update Neta until the holdout wave closes.
